name: Faint Hum
description: Hum the first faint note of the soul beside an ally so their small soul work steadies and clears.

name: Pitch Taking
description: Listen for the pitch of an ally's soul so the user can match it without a clash.

name: Soft Unison
description: Match the user's soul note to an ally's and hold both together so the ally's work rings true.

name: Quiet Ring
description: Hold a quiet ring of soul tone around the user that dulls a small stir of hostile soul force.

name: Hum Mending
description: Hum a slow note through the soul of a strained ally to ease the ache of a minor soul strain.

name: Tone Prick
description: Prick an opponent's soul with a single sharp tone that startles them and breaks their focus for a moment.

name: Fork Reading
description: Sound one note of soul force and read how it rings back from an ally to learn the pitch they hold.

name: True Pitch
description: Hold a clean pitch beside an ally until their wavering soul technique settles to the same pitch.

name: Even Beat
description: Tap a steady beat in the soul so an ally's rhythm of casting stays even under pressure.

name: Hush Tone
description: Flatten a hostile soul tone with a calm tone of the same pitch before it can bite.

name: Mender's Note
description: Sing a low note through an ally's frayed soul to draw its loose threads back together.

name: Tuned Lance
description: Narrow a tuned tone to a lance that finds the weakest pitch in an opponent's soul and pierces it.

name: Shared Breath
description: Pace the user's breath with an ally's so that both souls pull on the same slow measure.

name: Matched Note
description: Set the user's soul note beside an ally's until the two sound as one clean line.

name: Bell Ear
description: Strike a small bell of soul force and listen for the echo of any soul close by.

name: Steady Drone
description: Lay a low steady drone under an ally's work so it does not waver when pressed.

name: Ringing Bell
description: Ring a bell of soul force before the user that breaks the shape of an incoming soul jab.

name: Mend Chime
description: Chime a clear note over an ally's bruised soul so the ache fades as the ring dies away.

name: Chime Rap
description: Rap a hard chime of soul force against an opponent's mind so it rings and stuns for a breath.

name: Beat Count
description: Count the beat of an ally's soul pulse to learn how fast they tire and how well they hold.

name: Tempo Lend
description: Lend a steady tempo to an ally so the pace of their soul work does not hurry or drag.

name: Rest Beat
description: Place a quiet rest between the beats of an ally's soul so that a strain eases over a slow count.

name: Even Pulse
description: Keep the user's soul beating at an even pulse so hostile soul force finds no seam to enter.

name: Beat Break
description: Strike on the off beat of an opponent's soul to throw their casting rhythm out of time.

name: Lent Voice
description: Lend the user's soul voice to an ally so that their weak soul technique carries with a fuller sound.

name: Voice Check
description: Call a soft note across a gathering and hear which souls answer strong and which answer thin.

name: Sung Mend
description: Sing a gentle line over an ally whose soul is worn thin until it fills out again.

name: Small Choir
description: Gather two or three allies to sing one note in the soul so each leans on the strength of the others.

name: Throat Ward
description: Close the throat of the soul against a hostile word of soul force so it cannot find the mind.

name: Open Vowel
description: Open the soul note like a long vowel so an ally's focus widens and takes in more of the work.

name: Reed Sting
description: Sound a sharp reed note against an opponent's soul so that it stings and flusters their aim.

name: Answer Back
description: Return an ally's soul note and follow it at once with a second so the two notes land as one blow.

name: Common Chord
description: Sound a chord that three souls can share so allies of one rung lend each other clarity.

name: Chord Listen
description: Listen for a missing voice in a group chord to learn which ally has fallen out of tune.

name: Root Note
description: Sound the low root of a chord so that every ally above it finds its footing and holds.

name: Chord Shield
description: Stack three soul tones into one wall of sound that spreads a hostile blow across all of them.

name: Chord Mend
description: Fill the gap in an ally's soul tone with the missing note of the chord until it is whole.

name: Chord Strike
description: Slam a dissonant chord of soul force into an opponent so their thoughts jar and scatter.
